_comment: Phase 2 wrap-up grid for tune_reconciler.py: folding fragments. A
label minted within fragment_fold_sec whose audio the next window
re-labels as another speaker (at least fragment_fold_fraction of the
fragment's audio inside that window) is folded into that speaker
before its captions settle. 5.5 s = the next pass only at a 5 s
period, 10.5 s = the next two passes. Phase 2b defaults otherwise.
